# Security policy

Ziggy Bot runs on your own PC, keeps your data there, and asks before anything that can't be undone. If you find a way
around any of that, I want to hear about it first, privately.

## Reporting a security problem

**Please don't open a public issue for a security problem.** Email **zygpolski@proton.me** instead, with:

- the Ziggy Bot version (shown at the bottom left of the window);
- what you found, and how to make it happen again;
- what someone could do with it.

You'll get a reply within a few days. Once it's fixed, the fix arrives for everyone through Ziggy Bot's built-in
updates, and I'm glad to credit you in the release notes if you'd like.

## Which versions get fixes

Only the [latest release](https://github.com/Zygpolski/ziggybot-releases/releases/latest). Ziggy Bot updates itself
when you press **Update**, so keeping up to date is one click.

## Downloading safely

Download Ziggy Bot only from this page's [releases](https://github.com/Zygpolski/ziggybot-releases/releases). Every
release lists its installer's fingerprint (SHA-512) in `latest.yml`, and Ziggy Bot checks each AI model file against its
published fingerprint before it's used.
